```{r}
## UPDATE JAVA!!!!!!!

library(RSelenium)
library(rvest)
library(xml2)
library(dplyr)

park_code <- "ARCH"

url <- paste0(
  "https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/SSRSReports/",
  "Park%20Specific%20Reports/Recreation%20Visitors%20By%20Month%20",
  "(1979%20-%20Last%20Calendar%20Year)?Park=",
  park_code
)

# selenium
driver <- rsDriver(
  browser = "chrome",
  chromever = "latest",
  geckover = NULL,
  phantomver = NULL,
  iedrver = NULL,
  port = 4444L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

remDr <- driver$client
remDr$open()
remDr$navigate(url)

```

```{r}
iframe <- remDr$findElement(
  using = "css selector",
  value = "iframe"
)

remDr$switchToFrame(iframe)

html <- remDr$getPageSource()[[1]]
page <- read_html(html)

tables <- page |>
  html_elements("table") |>
  html_table(fill = TRUE)

tables
```
